questions.question: What is Geography, and what three questions does a geographer ask about a place?
questions.expected_answer: Geography is the study of the Earth's places, the people who live there and their environment. A geographer asks where a place is, what it is like and why it is like that.

questions.question: Explain the difference between informal and formal assessment.
questions.expected_answer: Informal assessment happens almost every day, through class work, homework and short activities. It does not count for the report but shows what you still need to practise. Formal assessment, such as tests, a controlled test and a project, has marks that count for the report.

questions.question: Give one advantage of a globe and one advantage of a map.
questions.expected_answer: A globe shows the true shapes and sizes of land and sea, because it is round like the Earth. A map is flat, easy to carry and fold, and can show much more detail.
